title: Fixtures and Test Data
description: Master pytest fixture dependency injection: @pytest.fixture decorators, fixture scopes (function, class, module, session), yield-based teardown lifecycle, reusable test datasets, parameterized testing with @pytest.mark.parametrize, and filesystem isolation with tmp_path.

lessons.title: pytest Fixtures, Teardown Lifecycles, and Parameterization
